##### Project general facts

Baccarat Residences is a masterfully designed two-tower development, offering uninterrupted views of the iconic Burj Khalifa. This project brings the world-renowned elegance of the Baccarat brand in a stunning showcase of craftsmanship and contemporary luxury. Each home is bathed in natural light and framed by thoughtfully composed architecture and interiors, blending timeless design with modern flair. Here, every detail is curated to meet the expectations of those who seek excellence — from the welcoming lobby to the bespoke finishes in each room.

Life at Baccarat Residences is elevated by an array of exclusive amenities designed to deliver the highest levels of service and serenity. Residents enjoy private access to a stunning infinity pool, fitness and yoga studios, wellness treatment rooms, and a tranquil lounge with private meeting areas. Families are catered to with a dedicated kids' play area, and fine dining experiences await at the onsite specialty restaurant. The combination of location, design, and service makes this project a beacon of sophistication, where life is lived beautifully.

The luxury units at Baccarat Residences are decorated in an exquisite style using marble, shimmering crystal, premium fabrics, wood, and other high-end materials. The color scheme of walls, floors, and ceilings in light colors perfectly harmonizes with bright color accents in rich burgundy and red shades. Kitchens are fully equipped, and residences are semi-furnished with built-in wardrobes or walk-in closets. Every detail reflects the Baccarat brand's commitment to beauty, craftsmanship, and unparalleled luxury.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Downtown Dubai, the centre of Dubai constantly evolving at a fast pace, this exceptional location is home to many landmarks and world-famous attractions including Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the Dancing Fountains. The prime location keeps Downtown busy throughout the year, with always some new things to do in this vibrant hub of activities.

The location is distinguished by its luxurious lifestyle and excellent connectivity. Strategically located along Sheikh Zayed Road and bordering Business Bay, Downtown is well connected to other key commercial and residential areas in the city. It is one of Dubai's best areas for non-drivers and frequent travellers, with upscale hotels, chic leisure points, and massive shopping centres making it a sought-after address and "the centre of now."

For those seeking a residence that embodies the pinnacle of luxury, cultural vibrancy, and a prime Dubai address, Downtown Dubai delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class attractions, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
